subject: Future Tech
title: Xenotransplantation: Animal Organs for Humans
description: A 60-second lesson on Xenotransplantation: Animal Organs for Humans.

hook.text: Over 100,000 Americans wait for organ transplants. There are never enough donors. Pig organs could fill the gap.

buildup.text: Pig organs are similar in size to human ones, but the human immune system attacks them violently within minutes.

discovery.text: CRISPR edited ten pig genes at once to remove sugar molecules that trigger rejection, making pig organs tolerable.

twist.text: In 2022, a pig heart was transplanted into a human for the first time. The patient survived two months before dying.

climax.text: Pig kidney transplants followed in 2024 with longer survival.

punchline.text: Edited pigs may end the organ shortage crisis.

quiz.question: What did CRISPR remove from pig organs to reduce human immune rejection?
